roadmap_note: One playthrough, about 200 hours, no online trophies, no mission replay. Finish the story first, then the 100% checklist, then Strangers & Freaks and cleanup.

trophies.guide: The last trophy you will ever pop. Earn the other 54 and this one lands on its own the moment the final one does. There is no shortcut and nothing online: every requirement sits in single-player.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: The opening mission. Play through the first job as Lucia and Jason until the mission-complete screen appears; the trophy pops with it. Nothing to prepare and nothing to miss.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Finish every Chapter 1 main mission. The trophy lands when the chapter closes and the story rolls into Chapter 2. Story trophies cannot be missed, so just keep playing.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost

trophies.guide: Finish every Chapter 2 main mission. It pops as the chapter ends and Chapter 3 begins. Like all chapter trophies, it is automatic and cannot be missed.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money

trophies.guide: Finish every Chapter 3 main mission. It unlocks after the first two missions of Chapter 4, when the game counts Chapter 3 as done. Automatic, unmissable.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!

trophies.guide: Finish every Chapter 4 main mission, ending with Starting From Zero. The trophy pops as the chapter closes and the final stretch of the story begins.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma

trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story. It pops at the end of the last job, and after the credits the whole map stays open for free-roam cleanup. This is the only hidden gold trophy.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run. It is a story mission, so it pops on its own when the mission ends. No extra step is needed.
trophies.name: Trust

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 3 main mission The Cartel Heist. Story mission, automatic pop at the end of the job, and it cannot be missed.
trophies.name: Break the Bank

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play. It pops when the mission ends, like every other story-mission trophy on this list.
trophies.name: Family Matters

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners. Story mission, automatic pop when the job is done.
trophies.name: DWNFALL

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown. It pops at the end of the mission, no extra requirement.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked

trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory. The last of the named-mission story trophies; it pops when the mission ends.
trophies.name: Snow Storm

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy on the list and the long grind after the story. The checklist appears under Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion once the credits roll, but progress made during the story already counts. It is forgiving, closer to 60% true completion: scan 200 of 277 vehicle models, study 100 of 255 animals through binoculars, finish any 70 of 80 challenges, complete 300 stunts, clear every robbery (39 gang operations, 22 bank jobs, 7 payday loan jobs, 8 bank vaults), all shooting ranges and drone races, Bret's 15 target decks, 15 of 18 meditations and 15 of 18 card sets, plus any 100 optional missions. Nothing on the checklist is missable, and everything stays open in free-roam. Budget around 100 hours after the story.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts across Leonida. There are four kinds: 130 stunt jumps over ramps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. Mix them however you like; flying under bridges is the quickest to rack up. Track them under Progress, then Activities, then Stunts, and on the map under Exploration, then Stunt Spots. The 100% checklist wants 300, so this trophy pops on the way there.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Do each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race (car race, race challenge or drone race) and performing a stunt. Check your count under Touchpad, then Progress, then Activities. Most of them happen on their own while you work on other trophies, so do not chase this one early.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 shooting range challenges spread across 12 ranges. The ranges are part of the 100% checklist too, so this pops while you work on that. Take it slow, aim for the head and chest zones, and retry a challenge right away if you fall short of gold; there is no penalty for retrying.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a drone race at all 14 Top Fun locations (42 races in total across them). One win per location is enough; you do not need to win every race at each spot. Drone races are also on the 100% checklist, so this lands during that grind.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Car races, race challenges and Top Fun drone races all count, so the easiest route is to mix them: clear the drone races for Top Fun, then mop up car races and race challenges until you hit 20. Each race only counts once, so pick a fresh location every time.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: After the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal, he will text you a fishing spot marked with a purple icon on the map. Follow his fishing questline and beat him in a challenge. Fishing is one of the 9 activity types, so this also helps Master of None.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle

trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of one of the 4 arcade games, called Video Games in-game: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, while Bang For Your Buck sits on arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end of one game once; the extra challenges inside each game are optional. Pick whichever you like best.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's questline is Lucia-only and opens in Chapter 3, when Andy calls Lucia and texts her home address in Belville. Finish all 5 of her quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1 to 3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass. Everything stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's questline opens in Chapter 1, a while after the mission Island Dreams. He calls you, then shows as a green KR icon in Key Lento. His quests are treasure dives: he marks purple chest icons on the map, you find the treasure on the ocean floor with a metal detector and bring it back. Clear 7 shipwrecks in total. Kenton goes quiet for a stretch after Chapter 1 but comes back in Chapters 2 to 3, so nothing is missable. Track him under Progress, then Characters, then Kenton Rees.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's questline opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, marked at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. Finish all 5 of his quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes. Everything stays available after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 Strangers & Freaks strands. Not every side questline counts: Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this one. Confirmed strands that do count are Kirk (the Skunk Ape hunt), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing) and Pilot Pete (package deliveries), with more still being found. Strangers stay available in free-roam after the story, so work through them in step 3 of the roadmap. Check your count on the trophy tracker in the PS5 trophy list.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's questline, Randy's Wish List, opens after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs, where you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. He wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage (green RK icon, west Vice City). Scan high-end cars with the WAiNK app to check if one is on his list, then drive it back in good condition for a better payout. Track the list under Map, then Robberies, then Randy's Wish List. It all stays open after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's questline is Jason-only and opens after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty. Purple markers appear for Synthetic Labs in Vice City: go in and destroy them in the quest Take Out Kitty Litter. Once enough labs are down, Tyrone hands you Spin On This, and finishing it pops the trophy. Everything stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 spots across 10 locations. You can meditate with Jason and Lucia at each spot, which counts as 2 at the same place. Track them under Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. THE MISSABLE ONE: the first meditation only happens in Chapter 1 at Jason's house. After the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning; she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you follow her and choose Accept. That meditation raises the counter by 1 but is not marked as a spot like the others, and it is still unconfirmed whether the trophy needs it, so do it while you can. The last spot needs both characters playable together, which opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break. The 100% checklist only asks for 15 of 18, so a missed Chapter 1 spot cannot cost you the gold.
trophies.missable_note: The Chapter 1 balcony meditation at Jason's house is the only missable step in the whole list. Do it before Chapter 1 ends.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret Vogel's questline is Jason-only and opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when Bret texts Jason and marks Veteran Hunted in Lummox County. His quests ask you to hunt specific animals he requests and bring them back. On the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, which you can pull from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nation. One clean shot keeps the animal pristine and pays more, but it is not required. Track the hunts under Map, then Activities, then Target Deck: there are 15 target decks and all 15 are needed for 100%, so this trophy should pop on the way. Which exact animal triggers it is still being confirmed.
trophies.name: Fair Game

trophies.guide: Complete any 3 of the 18 collectible card sets (480 cards in total). The shortest route is the two smallest sets, Backyard Wrestling (12 cards) and Delights Dancers (18 cards), plus any 24-card set: 54 cards in all. Cards sit in yellow phone boxes outdoors and on surfaces inside enterable buildings; use Focus to highlight nearby spots and watch for the yellow card icon. Track them under Progress, then Collections, then Collectible Cards. Cards can be sold at pawn shops for $20 to over $1,000, and selling does not hurt your collection. The 100% checklist wants 15 sets, so this pops early on that road.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck

sources.name: PowerPyx — GTA 6 All Collectible Card Sets Locations
GTADB — GTA 6 Collectible Cards: All 18 Sets

trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK spots with the phone app: hold Up to open WAiNK, then hold R1 to scan. There are far more than 100 in the world, split across 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher tags, so scan anything that glows as you pass it. This is also how you discover vehicles for Whip It Good, so the two trophies feed each other.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges. Track them under Progress, then Challenges; a checkmark in the bottom right shows which ones you have done. Most of them complete on their own while you work on other trophies, so leave this one late and then pick the easiest ones left. The 100% checklist needs 70, so this trophy pops automatically on that road.
trophies.name: One Last Thing

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you. You can only do this after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Cause chaos until you hit 4 stars, then break out of the red heat zone on the map: a fast sports bike through traffic works well, and the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County is a good escape route because cops and the helicopter struggle to follow you there. It also pops on its own during the Chapter 4 bank vault robberies, which always trigger 4 stars.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner while keeping your wanted level the whole time. Call your partner (hold Right, press Triangle), then hit 3 robbery targets, the green icons on the map, without letting the wanted level drop. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and Zombix or Adrenaline for healing. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, open after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: loot a couple of items in each and break the safe with sticky bombs. The pop is delayed by about half a minute after you leave the third shop; if it does not fire, hit a fourth shop and keep going.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app: hold Up to open it, look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan. You do not need to drive them; scanning is enough. Stand on a busy road and scan everything that passes. There are 557 vehicles at launch, and the 100% checklist needs 200 of the 277 base models scanned, so this pops naturally. Check your totals under Touchpad, then Progress, then Vehicles.
trophies.name: Whip It Good

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and weak points light up, draining the purple focus bar. Buff your focus first with food and drinks, and use Adrenaline (hold L1, press Triangle) to stretch the slowdown. Line up 5 enemies, an assault rifle like the Duke 556 works best, and wear body armor so you can step out of cover. Gang operations are a good hunting ground. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus levels up through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so it gets easier as you play.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at Vice City International Airport, one connected to a boarding bridge, not the planes parked on the airfield. The easiest is at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane, and use the stairs next to the boarding bridge to get inside. Go upstairs into the cockpit, reverse the plane back to the strip, take off and fly at least 1 km away from the airport. The pop is slightly delayed, so keep flying until it fires.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can

trophies.guide: Steal a Rhino military tank. They stand in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Drive through the gate, or use the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, then climb into a tank and fire the cannon at enemies until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. That unlocks the Snap Gun for silent lockpicking and marks jewelry store robberies with green icons. Break in through the back door and choose the Snap Gun prompt, never the kick, or the alarm goes off. Inside, find the note with the safe code and loot the safe. A good spot is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City. If the alarm trips, leave and try another store.
trophies.name: Sneakthief

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, which introduces vault robberies: tail a security van to a bank, wait for the guard to open the vault, go in fast and rob it. Bring your partner, because you cannot carry all the cash alone; hold Right to hand off a bag. After that mission, Yasmani sells tips on security vans for $10,000 once you have done his earlier quests, marking vans with a purple icon. There are 8 large bank jobs in total and the 100% checklist needs all 8, so this pops on the way. Robbing a vault triggers a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast bike and switch cars to shake the heat.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape the heat. The same Chapter 4 mission that unlocks bank vaults counts for this one: robbing a large bank vault counts as an armored truck robbery, so it pops while you work on Maximum Withdrawal. For an earlier shot, watch for armored trucks driving near banks in Vice City, block one's path, plant a sticky bomb on the back door and blow it open, then escape the red heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play

trophies.guide: Unfog the whole map: all 52 areas of Leonida. The fastest way is by plane: fly over every patch of black fog until the map is fully visible. Do this after the story, when you can fly anywhere freely, and it will also surface activity icons and robbery spots you have not found yet.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 gang operations in total, marked with yellow icons when you go near them, and many are marked automatically as the story progresses. Track your count per gang under Progress, then Gangs. The 100% checklist needs all 39, so this pops on the way there.
trophies.name: Pest Control

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar at the Oceanview Hotel on Ocean Beach. Walk past the pool to the rooftop access door, take the lift up, buy the $10 Apple Martini at the rooftop bar and drink it while standing by the bar. The trophy pops as you drink with the view in front of you.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal the blue Bravado Banshee from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City and drive it straight through the showroom window. You need the Key Cloner first, unlocked in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs. Clone the car's key, get in, drive forward through the glass and keep going down the street; the pop is slightly delayed. It only works with this exact blue Banshee, a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.
trophies.name: Capital Offense

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. Inside you need: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office, which you blow open with sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you grab the third item. You go there during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. If you miss an item, the robbery icon respawns after a while, so you can go back for the rest; it is not missable.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling

trophies.guide: Reach maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength under Touchpad, then Jason & Lucia, then scroll to Strength (the heart icon). You can only start after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Work out at fitness clubs: buy a membership, and always bring your partner along (hold Right, press Triangle), because while one character trains, the other finishes their workout too, doubling your progress. You can also work out at home after the story.
trophies.name: Personal Best

trophies.guide: Make 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. Click the trophy in the PS5 trophy list to see your count out of 500. Turn on the notifications first (Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, then Criminal Profile), so a small demon face appears on screen whenever an action counts. Actions fall into profiles: Professional for stealthy objectives and clean escapes, Hardened for incapacitating enemies without killing them, Violent for killing enemies and civilians, Psycho for mass killing, and Irredeemable, which is permanent, so avoid going that far. It mostly pops on its own while you work on the other trophies; if it is still short at the end, farm it by running over civilians and cops with a car.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder

trophies.guide: Rob the same Payday Loans store a second time. In the prologue Lucia robs a Payday Loans; come back to that same store in Little Cuba later in the game, as Lucia alone and without Jason. You need Payday Loans robberies unlocked first, which happens after the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, when you meet Raul's crew and get the Dye Pack Jammer. Go in, aim at the teller, deal with the security, break through the door and empty the 3 cash drawers, then escape on foot: the trophy only pops if you run away, not if you drive. The pop is delayed until you are clear of the police search area.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess

trophies.guide: Get abducted by a UFO in a random encounter in Kelly County. Go alone, without your partner, to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel after 2 a.m. in-game time. Look for a parked car with flickering lights at the roadside; if it is not there, drive away and come back to try again. Follow the path from the road into the woods toward the blue light, approach the UFO, offer to help the woman there and walk her back to her car. The UFO comes back and abducts you, and the trophy pops. Either Jason or Lucia can do it. It is not part of the 100% checklist, so it is easy to leave until the end.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock people over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle. The reported method is to kick pedestrians from a motorbike or bicycle: ride past them and press Square to kick. One report says 10 pedestrians within 60 seconds does it. Ocean Beach and busy Vice City streets have plenty of targets, so ride through a crowd and keep kicking. The exact trigger is still being confirmed by guide sites, so treat this as the best current method rather than a certainty.
trophies.name: Ten Pin

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check, where you meet Raul's crew and unlock the Dye Pack Jammer. Then rob banks and payday loans and carry the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 counts across all robberies, not in one trip. Bank vaults pay up to $205,000 in a single robbery, so this comes naturally while you clear the robberies for 100%.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops. It counts cumulatively, so every purchase adds up. The fastest way is the expensive stuff: guns at Ammu-Nation, car mods and tattoos. There are 24 Ammu-Nations, 14 mod shops, 67 clothing stores, 19 Pay 'n' Sprays and 11 tattoo studios, so you will pass $100,000 without trying while gearing up for the rest of the list.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 purchasable garages, $160,000 in total. They unlock after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, when you steal the Crawler for Moses and the Vice City Real Estate app lands on your phone. Buy them through the app. The 4 story garages do not count, only the 8 you buy. Robberies, especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3 and 4, are the quickest way to raise the money.
trophies.name: Little Boxes

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles in the Scooter Bros app. The app lands on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission where you take a vehicle to Moses. Each garage you own adds parking spots, so buy garages first (see Little Boxes). Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn, then choose Respray and Register in his garage. At first he only takes vehicles without trackers; from Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes.
trophies.name: On the Spot
